# D630 Linux — LLM project context

> Dell Latitude D630 / Intel Core 2 Duo project with two live operating systems, three kernel profiles and Core 2-tuned Gentoo userland builds.

This is a navigation/context file for LLMs. Coding-agent operational rules live in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Human instructions live in the component READMEs and user guides.

## Architecture

- `d630-tiny/`: standalone BusyBox shell with an external initramfs; no Gentoo root or Portage; RAM-only changes.
- `d630-gentoo/`: Gentoo/OpenRC live OS; read-only SquashFS root with volatile RAM OverlayFS.
- `kernels/profiles/20-d630-base.config`: modular overlay for conventional installed Gentoo.
- `kernels/profiles/30-d630-live.config`: standalone Tiny kernel profile; dedicated build/release pending.
- `kernels/profiles/40-d630-builtin.config`: built-in Gentoo SFS live kernel; current kernel workflow target.

## Current state

- Preferred Gentoo boot: GRUB loads kernel, external initramfs and SquashFS directly from a normal partition.
- ISO: retained as an optional packaging/distribution container. ISO-specific early userspace and end-to-end boot/persistence validation are incomplete.
- Tiny release `d630-tiny-shell-40818375822`: QEMU-tested; physical D630 validation pending.
- Gentoo release `d630-gentoo-openbox-2026.10.29`: QEMU console/OpenRC path tested; graphical and physical tests pending.
- Newest kernel bundle: `d630-kernel-6.18.56-run-41134237939`. Older pinned bundles must be retained while active workflows use them.
- Runner-state releases are encrypted full-root snapshots. Retain the newest two by policy; never disclose the decryption passphrase or decrypted contents.

## Hardware and compiler

Target: Intel Core 2 Duo T7250 (Merom), GM965/GMA X3100, Intel 3945ABG, HDA/SigmaTel, AHCI/ATA_PIIX, USB 2.0, legacy BIOS/GRUB.

Gentoo userland flags: `-O2 -pipe -march=core2 -mtune=core2`. Kernel: generic x86-64 ISA baseline with `KCFLAGS=-mtune=core2`; no `CONFIG_MCORE2` selector and no `-march=native` in CI.

## Build and test entry points

- `./scripts/validate-sources.sh`: static source/layout/README checks.
- `bash scripts/validate-kernel-profiles.sh` and `bash scripts/validate-kernel-config.sh`: static kernel config checks.
- `.github/workflows/`: kernel, Tiny, Gentoo runtime, runner save/restore and QEMU workflows.

Static validation is not compilation, image creation, QEMU boot, graphics verification or physical D630 testing.
